findings.evidence: Spectrum.lean:169-172 declares only `[CommRing K]`, `[LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L]`, `{h e f : L}` — no module, no field, no spectrum hypothesis; every proof body uses only `IsSl2Triple.mem_toLieSubalgebra_iff` from `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Sl2.lean:139`, which Basic.lean already imports (Basic.lean:7 `public import Mathlib.Algebra.Lie.Sl2`). The section's own docstring (Spectrum.lean:196-197) states the general purpose: "This is what lets the results proved for a generating triple be applied to an arbitrary one."
findings.fix: Move the five declarations into the `GeneratingTriple` section of `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Basic.lean` and drop `private`, so the restriction bridge sits with the other `toLieSubalgebra` facts and is available to CompleteReducibility and later layers; Spectrum.lean then just applies `toLieSubalgebra_isSl2Triple_restrict_eq_top`.
findings.issue: The `Restrict` section (lines 167-204: `e_mem_toLieSubalgebra`, `f_mem_toLieSubalgebra`, `h_mem_toLieSubalgebra`, `isSl2Triple_restrict`, `toLieSubalgebra_isSl2Triple_restrict_eq_top`) is generic `IsSl2Triple` theory over a bare `[CommRing K]` with no reference to eigenvalues, eigenspaces or modules. Its canonical home is `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Basic.lean`, whose `GeneratingTriple` section already collects exactly this material (`toLieSubalgebra_isSl2Triple_single_eq_top` at Basic.lean:269, `basisOfIsSl2Triple` at Basic.lean:362). It is the general bridge that makes every `htop : t.toLieSubalgebra K = ⊤` result in the repo applicable to an arbitrary triple — `lie_eq_zero_of_lie_lie_eq_zero` (Basic.lean:400), `exists_isCompl_of_toLieSubalgebra_eq_top` (CompleteReducibility.lean), the WeightString results — yet it is `private` inside a spectrum file, so no other file can reach it and the next caller must re-prove it.

summary: Placement is otherwise correct: the file joins the existing Sl2/ directory, its single import is used, and the deleted Classification lemma has no surviving references. The `Restrict` section, however, is general sl₂-triple theory with no connection to spectra and belongs in Sl2/Basic.lean.
